site: ADP (myjobs.adp.com) and job portals showing status on posting after submission
class: Terminal submission or already-applied state on job details page not recognized as confirmation
symptom: After submitting Heico on ADP, the site redirected back to the job posting where the Apply button changed to 'Applied'. The runner saw 0 fields and no next button, treated it as an unmoving page stall after 3 retries, marked status needs_user_review, and left the browser open waiting for user review.
root_cause: ADP does not show a traditional 'Thank you for applying' confirmation page; it redirects to /cx/job-details where the action button becomes 'Applied'. Neither _site_confirms() nor _says_already_applied() nor submission_confirmed() checked for ADP's 'Applied' button state.
why_tests_missed: Existing confirmation tests only checked for confirmation heading phrases ('Thank you for applying', 'Application received') or explicit Workday-style text notices, not button-state status switches on job details pages.
fix: Created dedicated AdpAdapter with is_adp_applied_posting() detecting ADP job-details pages with 'Applied' button and no form fields. Integrated into browser_automation.submission_confirmed(), page_agent._site_confirms(), and page_agent._says_already_applied() to classify as submitted when an application form was active (_seen_form or final_pressed) or already_applied when opening a previously applied posting.
prevention: Ensure portal adapters detect platform-specific terminal receipt states (like disabled/toggled 'Applied' action buttons) and classify them cleanly as submitted or already_applied rather than stalling into needs_user_review.
